rule: ep_meta lang of the first reset at this seed

instructions.ArrangeBreadBasket: Open the cabinet, pick up the bread from the cabinet and place it in the basket. Then move the basket to the dining counter.
instructions.ArrangeTea: Pick the kettle from the counter and place it on the tray. Then pick the mug from the cabinet and place it on the tray. Then close the cabinet doors.
instructions.BreadSelection: From the different types of pastries on the counter, select a croissant and place it on the cutting board. Then retrieve a jar of jam from the cabinet and place it alongside the croissant on the cutting board.
instructions.CategorizeCondiments: Put the shaker and condiment bottle from the counter next to their counterparts in the cabinet.
instructions.CloseBlenderLid: Close the lid blender by securely placing the lid on top.
instructions.CoffeeSetupMug: Pick the mug from the counter and place it under the coffee machine dispenser.
instructions.CuttingToolSelection: Place the appropriate cutting tool for cutting the eggplant skin on the cutting board.
instructions.DeliverStraw: Take a straw from the drawer in front and place it inside the glass cup on the dining counter.
instructions.GarnishPancake: Take the strawberry from the fridge and place it on top of the pancake, located on the dining counter.
instructions.GetToastedBread: Start the toaster. Once the lever pops up, take the bread to the plate on the dining counter.
instructions.KettleBoiling: Pick the kettle from the counter and place it on a stove burner. Then turn the burner on.
instructions.LoadDishwasher: Pick up the cup and bowl from the counter, place them in the dishwasher, and close the dishwasher door.
instructions.MakeIceLemonade: Grab a lemon wedge from the fridge and one ice cube from the ice bowl, and put them in the glass of lemonade.
instructions.PackIdenticalLunches: Place one mushroom and one chicken drumstick in each tupperware on the nearby counter, to pack two identical lunches.
instructions.PickPlaceCounterToCabinet: Pick the hot dog from the counter and place it in the cabinet.
instructions.PickPlaceCounterToStove: Pick the bell pepper from the plate and place it in the pan.
instructions.PickPlaceDrawerToCounter: Pick the whisk from the drawer and place it on the counter.
instructions.PortionHotDogs: Place one bun and one sausage from the bowl on each plate.
instructions.PreSoakPan: Pick the pan and sponge and place them into the sink. Then turn on the water.
instructions.PrepareCoffee: Pick the mug from the cabinet, place it under the coffee machine dispenser, and press the start button.
instructions.RecycleBottlesByType: Move the plastic bottles in the middle to the plastics group, and the glass bottles in the middle to the glass group.
instructions.RinseSinkBasin: Turn on the sink and manuever the spout to wash all locations of the sink basin.
instructions.ScrubCuttingBoard: Pick up the sponge from the counter and clean the cutting board by briefly scrubbing or pressing down on the cutting board. Once finished, release the sponge.
instructions.SearingMeat: Grab the pan from the cabinet and place it on the rear left burner on the stove. Then place the steak on the stove and turn the burner on.
instructions.SetUpCuttingStation: Pick up the knife from the drawer and place it on the cutting board. Then place the meat from the plate to the cutting board.
instructions.SlideDishwasherRack: Fully slide the top dishwasher rack in.
instructions.StackBowlsCabinet: Pick up the bowls on the counter and stack them on top of one another in the open cabinet. Place the smaller bowl on top of the larger bowl.
instructions.SteamInMicrowave: Pick the garlic from the sink and place it in the bowl. Then pick the bowl and place it in the microwave. Then close the microwave door and press the start button.
instructions.StirVegetables: Put the onion and onion in the pot. Retrieve the spatula and lightly stir the vegetables in the pot.
instructions.StoreLeftoversInBowl: Pick the chicken drumstick and bell pepper from their plates and place them in the bowl. Then put the bowl in the fridge.
instructions.TurnOffStove: Turn off the front left burner of the stove.
instructions.TurnOnElectricKettle: Press down the lever to turn on the electric kettle.
instructions.TurnOnMicrowave: Press the start button on the microwave.
instructions.WaffleReheat: Open the microwave, place the bowl with waffle inside the microwave, then close the microwave door and turn it on.
instructions.WashFruitColander: Put the colander in the sink, put the mango, pear, pear in the colander, and turn on the sink faucet and pour water over the colander.
instructions.WashLettuce: Wash the lettuce in the sink by running water over it.
instructions.WeighIngredients: Pick the yogurt and place it on the digital scale for weighing, and close the cabinet.
